test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 66 years. Two years from now, the average age of A and C will be 89 years. What will be the age (in years) of B, four years from now?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present sum of **A, B, and C** = (66 × 3) + (2 × 3) = 198 + 6 = 204 years.

Present sum of **A and C** = (89 × 2) − (2 × 2) = 178 − 4 = 174 years.

Present age of **B** = 204 − 174 = 30 years.

Age of **B** after 4 years = 30 + 4 = 34 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 34 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf5e1324b14a6847e8702c1c86599d76b661323ac5c618410ee731824cb8cb8.png] 

**Given:** Average age of **A, B, C** 2 years ago = 66 years. Average age of **A, C** 2 years hence = 89 years.

**Formula:** Total Age = Average Age × Number of persons.

⇒ Sum of ages of **A, B, C** 2 years ago = 66 × 3 = 198 years.

⇒ Present sum of ages (**A + B + C**) = 198 + (2 × 3) = 204 years.

⇒ Sum of ages of **A, C** 2 years from now = 89 × 2 = 178 years.

⇒ Present sum of ages (**A + C**) = 178 − (2 × 2) = 174 years.

⇒ Present age of **B** = (A + B + C) − (A + C) = 204 − 174 = 30 years.

⇒ Age of **B** after 4 years = 30 + 4 = 34 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 34 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Age Property

If the average age of n people is x years, then after t years, the average age will be (x + t) years.

Total Sum of Ages

When calculating the total sum after t years for n people, always add (n × t) to the current sum.

Weighted Average

Combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂) where n is the number of items and x is the average.</p
